'''Krysguld Dartis''' was a [[human]] [[Gender|male]] who worked as a lookout in his [[Pnakotic Coast village|home village]] on the [[planet]] [[Savareen]]. His [[tongue]] was cut out by the [[Crimson Dawn]] syndicate when he and the other villages stood up to them; however, he was still able to maintain an effective silent communications network. In [[10 BBY]], he was present when the [[Cloud-Riders]] and a [[Beckett's gang|group of criminals]] formerly affiliated with Crimson Dawn joined together with the villagers to oppose the syndicate.

==Biography==
Krysguld Darti was a [[human]] [[Gender|male]] who lived in a [[Pnakotic Coast village|village]] constructed in the ruins of the [[Bis Refinery]] on the [[Pnakotic Coast]] of his [[homeworld]] [[Savareen]].<ref name="SoloOG" /> Like the other inhabitants of the village, he had had his [[tongue]] cut out by the [[Crimson Dawn]] syndicate after the villagers stood up to the criminals and refused to pay tribute.<ref name="Solo">''[[Solo: A Star Wars Story]]''</ref> He worked as a lookout for the village, keeping an [[eye]] on any approaching [[starship]]s from a beach near the village and gauging whether or not they posed a threat to his community.<ref name="SoloOG" />

When Dartis believed danger was coming he would send a tap-code command to the villagers, warning them to hide in burrows and cove shallows until the threat had passed.<ref name="SoloOG" /> In [[10 BBY]],<ref name="Date">''[[Solo: A Star Wars Story The Official Guide]]'' dates the events on [[Savareen]] in ''[[Solo: A Star Wars Story]]'' to nine years after the [[Proclamation of the New Order|formation]] of the [[Galactic Empire]]. ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas]]'' dates the formation of the Empire to [[19 BBY]], therefore the event on Savareen in ''Solo'' must take place in [[10 BBY]].</ref> he was present in the village when a group of Crimson Dawn affiliates led by the criminal [[Tobias Beckett]] landed in order to process [[coaxium]] they had stolen from the planet [[Kessel]]. He then witnessed the stand-off between the criminals and the [[Cloud-Riders]] gang and aided the two groups when they worked together to defeat the forces of the Crimson Dawn when they arrived on Savareen to collect the coaxium.<ref name="Solo" />

==Personality and traits==
Krysguld Dartis had a keen [[eye]] and was able to maintain an effective silent communications network. He had dark skin, [[Color|brown]] [[eye]]s and black [[hair]].<ref name="SoloOG" />

==Equipment==
Dartis used a [[tap-code comlink]] and a [[location transponder]] which he wore around his neck and carried a [[club]] with a head that could be electrified by turning a dial beneath it. Like the rest of his villages he wore striped [[Clothing|robes]] of many colors.<ref name="SoloOG" />

==Behind the scenes==
Krysguld Dartis first appeared in the [[2018]] film ''[[Solo: A Star Wars Story]]''<ref name="Solo" /> and was first named in the accompanying reference book ''[[Solo: A Star Wars Story The Official Guide]]'', which was written by [[Pablo Hidalgo]].<ref name="SoloOG" />
